messages.content:
Assign the three-character ICD-10-AM principal diagnosis category for the episode below. Respond with exactly {"code": "<letter><digit><digit>", "condition": "<short name>"} and no other text.

Hospital course:
Discharge Summary:

Patient Information:
Name: [Redacted]
Age: 53
Sex: Female
Date of admission: [Redacted]
Date of discharge: [Redacted]

Hospital Course:

The patient was admitted with a one-week history of abdominal pain, constipation, nausea, vomiting, and a single episode of bright red blood per rectum. Two days following her presentation, she developed bilateral facial weakness, perioral numbness, and difficulty in swallowing initiation. On examination, the patient had diminished bilateral facial musculature strength and an absent left patellar reflex. CT and MRI of the brain were obtained and showed changes consistent with chronic small vessel ischemic disease. Neurology was consulted and recommended a lumbar puncture which showed increased protein with absent white and red blood cells, raising the suspicion of Guillain-Barré syndrome. The patient was started on intravenous immunoglobulins and monitored in the progressive care unit. After a five-day course of IVIG, the patient showed a slight improvement but did not show up for her follow-up appointment and left against medical advice on day 9 of hospitalization.
Discharge Diagnosis: [diagnosis section withheld]
Discharge Instructions:

The patient is advised to seek medical attention immediately if she experiences any new neurological symptoms such as numbness, tingling, or weakness in the extremities. She is also advised to attend all scheduled follow-up appointments and continue any prescribed medications as per the instructions of her primary care physician.

Respond with the JSON object only, starting with { and ending with }.
